design_note: Three atomic reference facts cover 6 days of vaginal itching, 3 nights of nonprescription vaginal antifungal cream use, and persistent thick white vaginal discharge today, with a 2-word span difference (20 vs 22 words) and 6 identical trailing tokens ('today so I should see a'). Replacing atomic fact f3 with new severe lower belly pain today stays inside the same gynecologic presentation and escalates care from outpatient doctor (level 2) to ER (level 4) with zero stated negatives.
